The pale dried tidemark of rainwater and a few grains of wet gravel on the tiles just inside the garden door are left to a floor decal in code.

rooms.name: Upstairs Corridor
rooms.note: The long second-floor corridor. Enter from the head of the main stair through the opening in the back wall; the study door is at the far end in the front wall. The attic stair door is near the back of the left wall, under the family portraits; the opening into the guest wing is at the front end of the right wall, where the glove lies on the carpet at the corner.

rooms.name: Ambrose's Study
rooms.note: The crime scene at the end of the upstairs corridor. Enter through the forced door at the left end of the back wall. The north wall (front) is six floor-to-ceiling bookcase sections, 3.5 ft each; the fourth from the left is the hinged one. Visit A: shelf shut. Visit B (study_shelf B): the fourth section stands swung out on its left-hand hinge and the taped opening behind it leads down the servants' stair. The two sash windows in the right wall are thirty feet above the terrace.

rooms.name: The Guest Wing
rooms.note: A narrower second-floor hall turning off the upstairs corridor, with the guests' rooms. Enter from the corridor through the opening in the back wall. Felix's, Dr. Penrose's and Mrs. Lowell's doors are along the left wall in that order; the Rose Room is the last door, in the front wall at the end. The narrow attic stair door is at the far end of the right wall.

rooms.name: The Attic
rooms.note: A long attic under the slates, over the whole second floor. Enter from the narrow stair from the upstairs corridor through the back wall; a second stair at the front end comes up from the guest wing. The roof slopes over the long walls; the box code ceiling sits at the 9 ft ridge height, so code may lower the side walls. Ambrose's boxes run under the eaves along the right wall, the 1998 box missing from the middle row.

rooms.name: The Wine Cellar
rooms.note: The vaulted cellar under the main floor. Enter by the kitchen stair door in the back wall (the kitchen is not a location, so this door stays shut and leads nowhere in code). The electrical panel is on the left wall near the kitchen stair, the door to the service corridor further along the left wall; the brick port bins line the front wall; the areaway door is at the top of four stone steps against the front end of the right wall.

rooms.name: Service Corridor
rooms.note: The long old passage under the house. Enter from the wine cellar door in the back wall. The narrow stair up to the library's service door opens off the left wall near the back, the key cabinet a little further along; the coal room doorway is in the right wall; the passage ends at the front wall in painted paneling, where the right-hand half is the painted-over door to the servants' stair.

rooms.name: The Servants' Stair
rooms.note: A tall narrow shaft inside the walls from the service corridor up to the study. Enter from the painted-over lower door in the back wall; four stone steps lead up from it to the wooden flight, which climbs toward the front wall to a small landing about 23.5 ft up, where the back of the hinged study shelf opens. The case says the stair is a little under 3 ft wide; it is drawn 4 ft wide in a 6 ft shaft for walking room. No ceiling light: it is lit only by the investigators' phones and flashlights.

rooms.name: The Greenhouse
rooms.note: A Victorian lean-to greenhouse on the grounds, its back wall the old brick wall of the kitchen garden, glazed on the other three sides above a brick knee wall. Enter through the glazed door near the front of the left wall (the way from the house). The lanterns lean against the potting bench in the back-left corner; the iron stove stands against the brick back wall with its flue into it.

rooms.name: The Yew Maze
rooms.note: A clearing at the far side of the yew maze, outdoors in rain and fog. You come in along the path from the house at the back; the stone boundary wall runs along the front with the iron lane gate in the middle of it. Hedges close in on the left, right and back with gaps where paths lead on into the maze.

rooms.name: The Carriage House
rooms.note: A big 1903 fieldstone carriage house under renovation. Enter through the small side door in the back wall; the tall carriage doors are in the front wall and the inspection pit is in the floor straight in from them, so a car could back up to it. The pit model sits in a cut in the floor. Visit A: doors shut, pit floor intact. Visit B (chamber opened): doors open on the yard full of State Police vehicles, the pit broken open and taped off, more work lights and evidence markers.

rooms.name: The Gatehouse
rooms.note: The estate office inside the 1903 stone gatehouse at the bottom of the drive, refitted as an office in the 1980s. Enter through the door in the back wall; the security desk is in the front-left corner, the filing cabinets on the left wall, and the wide window in the front wall looks onto the guests' cars in the lot by the gate.

rooms.name: Blackwood Field Office
rooms.note: The Pittsburgh field office, built once from C003 (c003_office). Only this case's own things are listed here.

rooms.name: Carroway Community Foundation
rooms.note: Reception on the second floor of the Mercantile Building, a 1912 brick office building. Enter from the stair hall door in the back wall; Market Street windows in the front wall. Right wall: Susan Whitfield's open door near the front, Martin's office door (cut police tape) near the back; Martin's corner office runs behind Susan's office to the rear of the building over Mulberry Alley.

rooms.name: Susan Whitfield's Office
rooms.note: The director's office off the reception's right wall, part of the foundation location (no map pin of its own). Enter from the reception door in the back wall; its left wall is the Market Street side of the building.

rooms.name: Martin Keller's Office
rooms.note: The rear corner office of the foundation, as the police left it. Enter from the reception door (cut police tape) in the back wall. Corner windows: the front wall looks along Mulberry Alley toward Third Street; the right wall looks down on the rear lot and the bank's drive-through camera across the alley.

rooms.name: Martin Keller's House: the Spare Room
rooms.note: A small 1920s frame house at 23 Orchard Street. Martin's spare room is his home office. Enter from the hall door in the back wall; the street window is in the front wall; the kitchen opens off the right wall.

rooms.name: Martin Keller's House: the Kitchen
rooms.note: Second room of the keller_home location, through the open doorway in the spare room's right wall (that doorway is this room's back wall). The counter with the week's mail is straight ahead on the front wall, under the backyard window.

rooms.name: Hannah Keller's Apartment
rooms.note: The front room of a second-floor apartment in a 1920s brick duplex on Darlington Road, Squirrel Hill: living room with a kitchenette along the right wall. Enter from the stair door in the back wall; two windows on Darlington Road in the front wall, the desk under the left one.

rooms.name: Reddick Maintenance Services
rooms.note: A one-man contractor's block garage bay beside Route 30 East. You come in through the open roll-up bay door in the back wall, past the van parked nose-in; the steel desk and the office door with the clipboard are on the front wall, the workbench along the left wall.

rooms.name: Carroway Police Department, Detective Bureau
rooms.note: The second-floor detective bureau of a 1930s civic building at 40 Court Street. Enter from the corridor door in the back wall; windows on Court Street and the courthouse in the front wall; Bowman's desk under the right-hand window, Bowman's case board on the left wall.

rooms.name: Kiley and Strand, CPAs
rooms.note: Walter Kiley's partner's office on the fourth floor of an older building at 310 Grant Street, Pittsburgh. Enter from the corridor door in the back wall; the Grant Street window is in the front wall; floor-to-ceiling shelves on the left; the round table set for Martin's 9:00 meeting at the back right.

rooms.name: Suite 2210, 600 Grant Street
rooms.note: One open executive suite on the twenty-second floor, shared by Holt Advisory and Meridian's Pittsburgh office. Enter through the glass door in the back wall; the two nameplates are on the wall just inside, beside the door, with Carol Dunmore's reception desk ahead; Holt's desk faces the room from in front of the floor-to-ceiling window wall at the front.

rooms.name: Rear Lot and Service Entrance
rooms.note: The small parking lot behind the Mercantile Building, off Mulberry Alley. The back side is the building's rear wall with the service door, card reader and sidelight; the alley crosses the front of the area, with the bank's drive-through and its camera pole on the far side; the alley runs off to the left (west) and right (east, toward Third Street).

rooms.name: Blackwood Field Office
rooms.note: The Pittsburgh field office, built once from C003 (c003_office). Only this case's own things are listed here.

rooms.name: The Ashcroft Hotel
rooms.note: The lobby of an upscale 12-story hotel on Fifteenth Street NW near Thomas Circle. Enter from the street doors in the back wall and face the guest elevators. Front desk along the left wall, the security and general manager's doors and the valet podium on the right. Three camera domes: over the front desk, over the street doors and over the elevators.

rooms.name: Sixth-Floor Corridor
rooms.note: The north wing of the Ashcroft's sixth floor: one long straight corridor. Enter from the elevator landing at the back and face north toward service door S6-2 at the far end. Odd rooms 601 to 615 on the left, even rooms 602 to 616 on the right; 614 and 616 are the last two on the right. Camera C6-1 hangs over the landing; its useful view ends at about 608, 60 feet up. The ice alcove is on the left at the far end, out of the camera's sight.

rooms.name: Room 614
rooms.note: A king room at the north end of the sixth floor, left as Jonathan left it on Sunday night. Enter from the corridor in the back wall; the window over Fifteenth Street is ahead. Closet on the left by the door, bathroom on the right by the door. The bed's headboard is on the left wall; the desk sits under the window.

rooms.name: Hotel Security Office
rooms.note: A back-of-house office on the Ashcroft's lower lobby level, reached by the service stairs from the security door in the lobby. Enter from the stair door in the back wall; the monitor wall faces you over the console. Work-order board by the door on the right.

rooms.name: Sixth-Floor Service Vestibule
rooms.note: The bare back-of-house vestibule behind door S6-2. Enter through S6-2 in the back wall from the guest corridor; the service elevator S1 is straight ahead in the front wall, with its control panel and the scuff mark to its right. Fire hose cabinet on the left wall. The duct runs along the ceiling front to back (the model hangs just under the ceiling).

rooms.name: The Ashcroft Loading Dock
rooms.note: The covered receiving dock on B1, on the service alley behind the hotel. Enter from the service elevator S1 in the back wall and face the two open bays onto the alley. The engineering shop opens off the left wall, with the staff lockers on that wall just outside the shop door (in the old painting they were inside the shop, along its back wall: moved so locker 41 stands in the walkable room). The glass dock office stands at the front left; door D-B1-3 is on the right wall a few steps from bay 2, the compactor in the front right corner, the smoking bench at the back of the right wall. The dock floor stands about 4 feet above the alley.

rooms.name: Eastbridge Systems
rooms.note: Eastbridge's executive floor in a glass office building in Reston. Enter through the glass doors from the elevator lobby in the back wall; the badge desk and phone lockers are just inside (in the old painting the badge desk was in the ground-floor lobby: moved up so the room holds it). Jonathan's sealed glass office is on the left wall, seen into but never entered. Okoye's desk sits at the front by the wide window over Sunrise Valley Drive.

rooms.name: Law Office of Irene Chen
rooms.note: Suite 402 at 1150 Seventeenth Street NW. Enter from the suite's corridor door in the back wall. Bookshelf on the left wall with the filing cabinets and the fire safe in front of the left wall nearer the window; Chen's desk faces the door, the tall window over Seventeenth Street on the front wall to the right of center.

rooms.name: Meridian Advisory Group
rooms.note: Meridian's eighth-floor reception and Julian Rourke's corner office as one space. Enter from the elevators in the back wall; the reception desk faces you, the card-reader glass doors to the rest of the floor on the left wall. A glass partition across the middle of the room marks off Rourke's office, with open gaps at both ends; his desk faces the partition, the credenza stands against the window wall behind it. The plaque is by the elevators here (the hotspot text still places it in the ground-floor lobby). Visit A is before the federal search (RE08), visit B after: the credenza stands open on the empty safe and tape closes the left gap; Rourke is not present in visit B.

rooms.name: Kestrel Protective Group
rooms.note: Suite 210 in a low office building beside the Metro's Red Line in Rockville. Enter from the building hall in the back wall. The fleet board and staff whiteboard are on the left wall, the ops desk and printer at the front left, Lyons's executive desk under the window at the front right, the file cabinet on the right wall. Visit A is the open office (Lyons present); visit B is after the Montgomery County Police search: drawers out, the Northgate binder on the desk, placards on the carpet, an evidence tag on the fleet board, Lyons gone.

rooms.name: 4 Sawmill Hollow Road
rooms.note: The end of the gravel lane before the farmhouse. You arrive from the lane at the back (south) and face the house at the front (north), its porch toward you; the boarded upstairs window is on the house's left side at the back corner, built into the house model. Visit A is the watch before dawn (unmarked cars dark along the left verge); visit B is just after the entry (State Police cruisers, FBI sedans, the ambulance with Jonathan, Lyons in a cruiser by the fence). The front door leads to the upstairs room. The van and its mattress stay in both visits; the duffel is in visit B only. The "Tell Det. Collins" hotspot is an action with Collins, not an object. People: Collins in both visits, Quinlan, Jonathan and Lyons only in visit B.

rooms.name: The Upstairs Room
rooms.note: The back bedroom at the top of the farmhouse stairs, after the entry. Enter through the doorway in the back wall from the upstairs hall (which leads downstairs and out to the lane); the boarded window is straight ahead. The door is a separate model standing open into the room against the back wall, its hasp side facing in, so the hasp and padlock are visible.

rooms.name: Blackwood Field Office
rooms.note: The Pittsburgh field office, built once from C003 (c003_office). Only this case's own things are listed here.

models.note: Shown while Delivery 3 is still sealed; swapped for the open envelope once it is opened.
Shown once Delivery 3 is opened, until E022 is collected.

rooms.name: East Harbor Terminal, Gate 1
rooms.note: The apron outside Gate 1 on a rainy December morning. The gate lanes and the terminal are ahead (front), the queue runs back toward Broening Highway (back), the fence runs left toward Gate 4, and the union hall trailer sits across the road on the right.

rooms.name: Staging Area C
rooms.note: A fenced export staging area on a wet gray December afternoon. Enter by the pedestrian gate at the left end of the north fence; the lane at C-14 runs between two container rows, the flat racks stand against the north fence (front) fourteen feet from the stain, and the lashing gear cage sits at the end of C-14. One slot at the end of the row is left empty in code: that box has been loaded.

models.note: Set 2 feet off the north fence, leaving the hidden gap behind the stack.
In the C-14 lane, the scuffs running north toward the fence and the gap behind the flat racks, about fourteen feet away.
Strung 4 feet up between the corner castings of the two rows at the south end of the C-14 lane.
At the south end of row C-14, about forty feet from the stain.

rooms.name: Cargo Verification Office
rooms.note: Second floor of the Gate 1 building. Enter from the stair landing through the door in the back wall; the wide window ahead looks straight down on the Gate 1 lanes. Hector's cleared desk sits under the window, Joanne Lindqvist's desk in the middle, the shared terminal desk on the right.

rooms.name: Terminal Security Office
rooms.note: Ground floor of the Gate 1 building, beside the gate. Shares its block walls, tile floor, ceiling and base with the verification office upstairs. Enter through the door in the back wall; the camera wall is ahead, the access workstation on the left, the narrow window on Gate 1 in the right wall.

rooms.name: Lashing Gear Building
rooms.note: A steel shed beside Staging Area C. Enter through the steel door in the back wall; its badge reader and the clipboard hang just beside it, on your left as you come in. The workbench is along the left wall, the stores racks across the front, and the twenty-four gear lockers in a row along the right wall, numbered from the front corner, so locker 12 sits in the middle of the run.

models.note: Sits on the end of the workbench top.

rooms.name: The Navarro Home: Front Room
rooms.note: The front room of a two-story Highlandtown brick rowhouse, 3214 Fait Avenue. Enter from the street through the front door in the back wall, beside the front window; the doorway to the kitchen is ahead in the front wall. Marisol is found here.

models.note: Stands against the left wall, clear of the radiator and photographs.

rooms.name: The Navarro Home: Kitchen
rooms.note: The kitchen behind the front room, part of location navarro_home. Enter from the front room through the doorway in the back wall; the open door to the back room is ahead in the front wall. The refrigerator covered in Sofia's drawings stands where it is seen straight through the doorway from the front room.

models.note: Straight ahead through the front-room doorway, as the old scene showed it.

rooms.name: The Navarro Home: Back Room
rooms.note: The back room off the kitchen, part of location navarro_home: laundry and Hector's small desk. Enter from the kitchen through the doorway in the back wall; the back door to the yard is ahead. Hector's desk is wedged beside the washing machine.

models.note: Wedged against the right wall right beside the washer and dryer.

rooms.name: Operations Supervisor's Office
rooms.note: Russell Gaffney's office on the second floor of the Terminal Administration Building. Enter through the door in the back wall; the window over the quay is ahead, the binder shelf on the left wall, the framed photographs on the right wall, the desk facing the door with the two-drawer cabinet behind it.

rooms.name: EHTOC Accounts Office
rooms.note: First floor of the Terminal Administration Building, under Gaffney's office; shares its walls and carpet. Enter through the door in the back wall and stand at the service counter; Walsh's desk and the contracts shelf are behind it, the certificate on the front wall, the window on the lot in the right wall.

models.note: Against the front wall behind the counter, left of Walsh's desk.

rooms.name: Kane Logistics
rooms.note: Gideon Kane's office on the second floor of a converted brick warehouse at 1900 Clinton Street. Enter from reception through the door in the back wall; the lateral invoice file stands just inside, the big steel window on Clinton Street is ahead, the truck photographs and plaque on the left wall, the walnut desk facing the door with the credenza behind it. Visit A is the first call on a gray afternoon; visit B is the Tuesday evening search (credenza drilled open, boxes on the hand truck, the evening view).

models.note: Against the left wall just inside the door.
Spans left wall to right wall just under the ceiling, its top at 13 feet.
Spans left wall to right wall just under the ceiling, its top at 13 feet.

rooms.name: Fisk Freight Security
rooms.note: The office trailer in Fisk Freight Security's yard off Pennington Avenue. You come in through the trailer's end door in the back wall; the open trailer door in the right wall looks out on the yard and, until Fisk is in custody, his gray F-250 parked nose-out by the gate (the truck hotspot sits on that doorway and its outside view). Visit A: Fisk and his truck are here. Visit B: after his arrest, the truck is gone. The schedule board hangs on the left wall, the desk faces the room.

models.note: Turned to face the right-wall door, its long side along the room.
In the front right corner, clear of the window.

rooms.name: BPD Homicide
rooms.note: The homicide squad room on an upper floor of police headquarters, 601 East Fayette Street. Enter from the elevator hall through the double doors in the back wall; the case boards line the left wall, Whitaker's desk is in the near row on the left, the window on Fayette Street is ahead in the front wall, and the door and wired-glass window of Interview 3 are in the right wall.

rooms.name: BPD Homicide: Interview 3
rooms.note: A small interview room off the squad room, part of location police. Enter through the steel door in the back wall; the wired-glass window to the squad room is in the back wall beside it. Fisk sits here with his public defender once he is in custody.

rooms.name: Riverside Freight Transfer Yard
rooms.note: Kane's transload yard off Chesapeake Avenue on Wednesday morning, police on site. You come in by the gate shack at the entrance (back); the long three-bay shed runs along the left, bay 3 open, and Kane's block site office stands on the right. Its door leads into the site office room.

models.note: Bay 3 is the door nearest the front of the yard, around z 16.
Sits on the edge of the bay 3 loading dock, at container height.

rooms.name: Riverside Yard: Kane's Site Office
rooms.note: Kane's site office inside the block building at the Riverside yard, part of location riverside. Enter from the yard through the steel door in the back wall; the desk is ahead with the rubber mat rolled back beside it and the floor safe in the concrete, the drilled file cabinet on the right wall. Visit A: the safe is shut and the locksmith is waiting on a judge. Visit B: the safe stands open and the locksmith is packing up.

models.note: Pushed back against the front wall, off the mat.
Rolled back toward the room, uncovering the safe in front of the desk.

rooms.name: Blackwood Field Office, Pittsburgh
rooms.note: The Pittsburgh field office, built once from C003 (c003_office). Only this case's own things are listed here.

rooms.name: The Wren Coffeehouse
rooms.note: A small independent coffeehouse in a 19th-century brick storefront at 1108 King Street, Old Town Alexandria, a rainy Wednesday morning. Enter from King Street through the street door in the back wall, beside the storefront window. The counter runs down the left wall, the reserved back booth is in the front right corner under the waterfront print. Visit B is after Nina brings the envelope (flag note_given).

rooms.name: Cameron Mews
rooms.note: The ground-floor lobby of a three-story brick condominium at 1015 Cameron Street, Alexandria, a rainy midday. Enter from the street door in the back wall. The management window is on the left wall, the mailboxes on the right, and the glass back door in the front wall looks into the residents' garage. The stairs up to the third floor (and Apartment 3C) open off the right wall; Gwen Patel waits at the foot of the stairs.

rooms.name: Claire Donovan's Apartment
rooms.note: The main room of Apartment 3C, Cameron Mews, just after a thorough search, a rainy December afternoon: living area, kitchenette along the left wall, her desk under the front window. The bedroom closet and the bathroom open off the right wall (the one-bedroom is folded into one walkable room: the closet is reached from the main room). Enter from the hall door in the back wall. The bookcase kick plate hotspot appears after RE02 (code), with no change to the art.

rooms.name: Meridian Records Center
rooms.note: The front of house of a huge corporate records warehouse in a Chantilly office park. Enter from the lobby doors in the back wall, near the left. The reception desk with the stack register is just inside on the left; Claire's cleared desk sits at the head of the second aisle; rows of shelving run away toward the front wall; the glass-walled copy room with copier RM-C2 is on the right. Belt barriers close the aisle heads (the stacks are off limits).

rooms.name: Alan Corbett's House
rooms.note: The study of Alan Corbett's modest 1950s brick rambler at 214 Hillwood Avenue, Falls Church, a gray December afternoon. Enter from the hall door in the back wall. The window onto Hillwood Avenue is in the front wall; his desk is on the left wall; the six banker's boxes stand against the right wall.

rooms.name: Clearwater Accountability Initiative
rooms.note: Reception and open office of a small nonprofit, Suite 610, 1225 Nineteenth Street NW, Washington, a rainy December day. Enter from the glass suite door in the back wall; the reception desk and the donor wall are on the left, four staff desks to the right, the big window in the front wall. Visit B is after RE04: the Lockhart Foundation plaque has been taken down and lies on the reception desk.

rooms.name: Tyler Prentiss's Apartment
rooms.note: Apartment 1108 in a modern high-rise on Wilson Boulevard, Clarendon. Enter from the corridor door in the back wall; the floor-to-ceiling window wall in front looks down on the boulevard. Open kitchen and island on the left, his standing desk with the home server underneath on the right. The old painting was at night; the outside view is written for a gray rainy day, and code can darken it.

rooms.name: Dominion Secure Records
rooms.note: The inspection room of a secure document storage company in Lorton Industrial Park. Enter by the steel door in the back wall, the time clock beside it. A steel mesh gate in the front wall looks onto the vault aisles. The long inspection table stands in the middle. Visit B is after the carton warrant: carton P-0388 sits open on the table with its contents laid out.

rooms.name: Laurel Run Cottage
rooms.note: The one main room of a small rental country cottage at 3 Laurel Run Lane, Delaplane, a cold December afternoon with the heat off. Enter by the cottage's front door in the back wall (the front window beside it looks onto the gravel drive and Claire's frosted car). The kitchen is at the cottage's rear, toward the front wall, with the back door and the radiator there; the bedroom opens off the right wall beside the woodstove. The ladder-back chair by the table is set on its side by code (rotX).

rooms.name: Tate Protective Services
rooms.note: Suite 204, a small private security office on the second floor over a dry cleaner and a bank branch, 2900 Clarendon Boulevard, Arlington. Enter from the stair hall door in the back wall, the fleet board beside it. Tate's desk faces the door with the window behind it. Visit A: Tate is here. Visit B: under the warrant, Tate is gone and a police car sits in the lot.

rooms.name: 12 Saddle Ridge Lane
rooms.note: The kitchen of a new, sparsely furnished rental house on a cul-de-sac in Bristow, gray early morning on Friday just after the police entry. Enter from the living room opening in the back wall. Counter and side door on the left wall, the open basement door on the right wall, the front window onto the cul-de-sac in the front wall.

rooms.name: Alexandria Police Department
rooms.note: The Criminal Investigations bureau of the Alexandria Police Department on Wheeler Avenue, a rainy December day. Enter from the corridor door in the back wall. Detectives' desks fill the middle; Det. Harris's whiteboard is on the left wall; the windows over the parking lot are in the front wall. In the right front corner, built inside the room from partition models, the interview room (front) and the glass-walled family room behind it. Visit B is after the rescue: Claire is in the family room, Tate and his lawyer in the interview room, and the whiteboard changes.

rooms.name: Blackwood Field Office
rooms.note: The Pittsburgh field office, built once from C003 (c003_office). Only this case's own things are listed here.

rooms.name: Belgrave Grand Hotel, Lobby
rooms.note: A grand 1920s Park Avenue hotel lobby at East 53rd Street. Enter from the avenue through the revolving door in the back wall and face the ballroom doors in the front wall. Visit A is gala night (chapter 1), visit B is Friday daytime (chapter 2 on).

rooms.name: The Grand Ballroom
rooms.note: The Belgrave Grand's main-floor ballroom, set for 400. Enter from the lobby through the doors in the back wall; the stage is at the front, the stairs to the mezzanine open from the right wall near the stage. Visit A is gala night (location state A), visit B the morning after, being cleared (state B, ballroom_cleared).

rooms.name: Mezzanine Conference Corridor
rooms.note: A long carpeted corridor on the hotel mezzanine. Enter at the back from the top of the stairs up from the ballroom; Suites A to D open off the left wall, A nearest the stairs; the pantry door is on the right just off the landing; the window bay is the front wall and the staff door to the back of house is on the right wall at the far end.

rooms.name: Conference Suite C
rooms.note: A small private conference suite off the mezzanine corridor. Enter from the corridor door in the back wall (near its right end); the credenza is on the left wall, the window and side table at the front. Visit A is gala night with the body still in place; visit B is after the crime scene unit has cut the carpet.

rooms.name: Hotel Security Office
rooms.note: The hotel security office behind the front desk. Enter from the lobby through the staff door in the back wall; the monitor wall is on the left.

rooms.name: Service Corridor and Loading Dock B
rooms.note: The hotel's back of house: a concrete service corridor running from the staff door (back wall) to the bay of Loading Dock B (front wall), with service elevator 3 in the left wall. Friday, gray daylight at the dock door.

rooms.name: The Lockhart Foundation
rooms.note: The reception hall of the foundation's Fifth Avenue mansion. Enter from the vestibule through the front doors in the back wall; Dr. Lockhart's office opens through double doors in the front wall; Bellamy's office and the carved door down to the archive are on the right wall. Friday, a gray December day.

rooms.name: Foundation Records Archive
rooms.note: The lower level under the foundation's mansion. Enter down the narrow stair through the back wall; steel shelving racks run front to back.

rooms.name: Ogden Fiduciary Partners
rooms.note: Nathaniel's own office on the 31st floor of a Sixth Avenue tower. Enter from the firm's small reception through the door in the back wall; the window faces the avenue.

rooms.name: The Ogdens' Apartment
rooms.note: The living room of a prewar Upper West Side apartment, fourth floor. Enter from the apartment's entry hall through the door in the back wall; the windows are on the left onto West 87th Street; Nathaniel's study opens off the front wall; the hall closet is on the right wall near the entry. A gray December afternoon.

rooms.name: Marchetti Law Group
rooms.note: A small firm's open corner suite on the 27th floor of a Lexington Avenue tower: reception just inside the entry door in the back wall, Ms. Marchetti's glass desk at the front by the south windows (the Chrysler Building), a west window on the right wall (the Belgrave Grand's roof). Visit A is before the warrant, visit B under the warrant.

rooms.name: Knox Protective Services
rooms.note: A one-room office on the second floor over a tire shop on Northern Boulevard, Long Island City. Enter up the stairs through the steel door in the back wall; the window faces the boulevard and Manhattan. A rainy December day.

rooms.name: Larchmont Corporate Services
rooms.note: A corporate services office on the 19th floor of a Madison Avenue building. Enter through the door in the back wall; the office manager's front desk is just inside; the wall of mail slots is at the front with the long counter before it; the window is on the right wall, onto Madison Avenue. The office manager, Corinne Rhee, is not a character and is not placed.

rooms.name: NYPD Manhattan South Homicide
rooms.note: The squad room on an upper floor of an old precinct building. Enter from the stairwell door in the back wall; Det. Caruso's board is on the left wall; the door and observation window of the interview room (room s001c05_police_interview, same location) are on the right wall; wire-glass windows at the front.

rooms.name: Interview Room
rooms.note: The squad room's interview room, part of location police. Its back wall is the squad room's right wall from 7.5 to 19.5 feet back from the squad room's front wall; enter through the door there, with the observation window beside it.

rooms.name: Blackwood Field Office
rooms.note: The Pittsburgh field office, built once from C003 (c003_office). Only this case's own things are listed here.

rooms.name: Benjamin Sayer's House
rooms.note: The ground floor of a 1940s brick colonial, Thursday morning, December 27: the study (left half) open to the kitchen (right half). Enter from the front hall door in the back wall. The street window is on the left wall, the kitchen window over the sink on the right wall, and the bedroom doorway in the front wall at its right end. The lamp and legal pad sit on the study desk top at 2.5 ft; the fire safe sits on the floor in the desk's knee space; the answering machine and the mail sit on the counter at 3 ft. Dewey the cat sits under the kitchen table (not solid).

rooms.name: Meridian Records Center
rooms.note: The dock end of a 1990s records warehouse in Chantilly the morning after the fire. Enter from the open dock door in the back wall; the fire marshal's command post is just inside it, by the apron. Bay C is the burned cage seen through its doorway in the front wall, taped off. Bays A and B are the three empty shelving runs along the right side, with their aisle signs on the right wall above each aisle. The security office and the dock office are stations along the left wall rather than separate rooms: the security desk and the DVR rack (access printout on the keyboard and camera stills on the desk top at 2.5 ft), then the dock office clipboard on its nail and the schedule binder on its wall shelf. Visit A is before the FBI seals the scene; visit B (records_sealed) adds the FBI evidence tent over the salvage tables, the FBI tape across Bay C and the seal easel.

rooms.name: Meridian Advisory Group
rooms.note: The tenth-floor executive floor of Meridian's Washington headquarters on Friday morning, December 28, during the FBI search. Enter by the glass doors from the elevator lobby in the back wall. The Chair's stripped corner suite is seen through its open doors in the front wall. The assistant's desk and her open lateral file are on the left side; the finance corner credenza with the AP tray (on its top at 2.5 ft) is front left; the service elevator and its log are on the right wall near the front, and the door to Room 1011 is on the right wall near the back. The agents boxing files and Meridian's lawyer by the elevator are background extras, not case characters; the evidence box stacks stand in for the search.

rooms.name: Room 1011
rooms.note: Benjamin's former office off Meridian's tenth-floor executive floor; it shares the carpet, ceiling, base and lights of meridian_hq. Enter from the corridor door in the back wall, which leads back to meridian_hq. The window on the front wall looks down into the courtyard. The bookcase stands against the left wall; the policy binder and the manual stand on its second shelf at about 3.5 ft. The desk faces the door with the chair between it and the window; the blotter lies on the desk top at 2.5 ft, and the open bottom drawer is the ledger drawer.

rooms.name: Oduya Records Consulting
rooms.note: Suite 300 of an office park on Sunrise Valley Drive, Reston. Enter by the suite door in the back wall. The tape safe stands against the left wall; the server room is seen through the glass partition on the right wall (its glass door does not lead anywhere playable). The window on the front wall looks over the frozen pond. Caroline is usually by her desk.

rooms.name: Glenmore Court Residences
rooms.note: The lobby of a short-stay building in Silver Spring, visited Friday, December 28. Enter by the glass front doors in the back wall. The front desk is on the left side; the business center is seen through its glass wall on the left wall; the elevator in the front wall stands for the Unit 3C hotspot (the searched flat upstairs is described in its note, not built); the garage ramp exit door with its push bar is on the right wall near the front. If Ian wants Unit 3C walkable, it can be split out later as its own small room.

rooms.name: Frederick Transit Center
rooms.note: The waiting concourse of the Frederick Transit Center, visited Friday, December 28. Enter by the glass doors from the parking lot in the back wall. The security office is seen through its open door on the left wall; the customer service ticket window is in the front wall, left of center; the bus bay 4 door with its cracked schedule frame is in the front wall at the right; the glass doors to the cab stand are on the right wall. Bernadette Kovalenko (behind the ticket window) and the guard are extras, not case characters.

rooms.name: The Burkholder Farm
rooms.note: The Burkholder farm on Juniper Gap Road, overcast Saturday, December 29. An exterior; its height only sets the sky. You start in the farmyard by Burkholder's farmhouse porch (back right) and look up the lane to the tenant house on the ridge (front). The quarter mile from the porch to the tenant house is compressed to about 75 ft. The trail camera laptop is moved from the farmhouse kitchen to an oilcloth table on the porch (porch floor at about 2.5 ft) so it can be reached outdoors; the trail camera itself is on the fence at the lane mouth. Visit A is before the recovery (RE08): the Tahoe parked crosswise on the lane, the tenant house shut. Visit B is after: the searched Tahoe, the tenant house with its back door forced, and the root cellar as an open bulkhead beside the house (in the story it is reached by a trapdoor in the pantry), with Benjamin's satchel at its mouth.

rooms.name: The Lockhart Foundation
rooms.note: The president's floor at 1140 Fifth Avenue on Sunday, December 30: a formal reception gallery that holds the boardroom table given over to the subpoena production, the assistant's desk outside Evelyn's office, and the plaques with the founding photograph. Enter by the double doors from the hall in the back wall; the windows on Fifth Avenue are in the front wall; the closed door to Evelyn's own office is on the right wall near the front, beside the assistant's desk. The founding photograph hangs among the plaques on the left wall. Beatrice Lam, the agent and the foundation lawyer are extras. Evelyn is here until RE12.

rooms.name: Elena Marchetti's Law Office
rooms.note: Marchetti's corner office on the fortieth floor of a Lexington Avenue tower (the same office as S001C05's marchetti_office, now half emptied after the FBI's Saturday warrant; keep the two cases consistent if both are built). Enter by the door in the back wall. Windows fill the front and right walls; the low credenza under the front windows holds the dead orchid and the framed bar certificate that the old scene put on the sill. The two guest chairs face the desk; her defense counsel, an extra, sits in the right-hand one.

rooms.name: Pike Risk Services
rooms.note: Suite 610 in a Tysons office tower. Enter by the suite door in the back wall. The whiteboard hangs on the left wall of the main office rather than through the half-open back office door, so it can be walked up to. Visit A is the first visit (chapters 2 to 4); visit B is the Sunday chapter 5 search, which adds the red PITTSBURGH folder on the desk blotter (at 2.5 ft) and the stacks of evidence boxes. The agents and Pike's lawyer are extras.

rooms.name: Brandywine Fiduciary Company
rooms.note: The windowless records room of a trust company on Rodney Square, Wilmington. Enter by the oak door in the back wall, where the trust officer (an extra) keeps the sign-out sheet. Two banks of rolling shelves stand along the left side; the small reading table in the middle holds the Cardinal Point Trust file (at 2.5 ft); the long reading table on the right with its lamps, calculator and pad is where Walter works. It shares the schoolhouse globe light of the office.

rooms.name: Solvang Document Laboratory
rooms.note: The examination room of a forensic document laboratory on North Charles Street, Baltimore, on Saturday night. The windows on the front wall have their blinds shut, so no night view is needed. Enter by the lab door in the back wall. Irene Chen and Benjamin wait by the two chairs at the left wall; the imaging bench runs along the front wall with the comparison microscope beside it; the long light table stands in the middle. Visit B is after the archive is opened (archive_open): the nine printed exhibits lie on the light table top at 3 ft, using four shared models (register for ex_register; paper stack for ex_corr; paper spread for ex_fin, ex_intel, ex_enforce, ex_concealment, ex_release and ex_protocol; specimen cards for ex_spec). Dr. Solvang and Priya Natarajan are extras.

rooms.name: NYPD Squad Room
rooms.note: Det. Caruso's squad room in an old Manhattan station house (Manhattan South Homicide). Enter by the hall door in the back wall. The Ogden board hangs on the left wall beside Caruso's desk; the two wire-glass windows over the fire escape are in the front wall with radiators beneath. The other desks are colleagues' and empty. It shares the transit center's 2x4 troffer light.

rooms.name: FBI Washington Field Office
rooms.note: SA Quinlan's floor at 601 4th Street NW: a conference area with her workstation. Enter by the corridor door in the back wall. The window on Judiciary Square is in the left wall; the large wall screen is on the right wall, with the open door to the small video interview room beside it. Holt, Rourke and Kane appear only on that screen (recorded video from custody, with counsel), not standing in the room; code can show their faces there. Quinlan, Claire (after RE02) and Benjamin (chapter 3) are in the room.

rooms.name: Meridian's Former New York Office
rooms.note: The fourth floor of a converted printing plant on Skillman Avenue, Sunday morning, December 30, held by the NYPD for the FBI. Enter by the old wooden door at the back end of the right wall; the shredding work ticket is taped to its inside face. The freight elevator the cartons came up in is in the back wall. The tall factory windows in the front wall look over the rail yards to Manhattan. The Chair's cartons stand on two pallets below the windows: the first pallet is st_plan, the second st_review, and the open carton with the folder marked C. beside them is st_castell; the older EX-CORR carton sits apart. No trim: brick walls run straight to a concrete floor. Vito Scarpa is an extra.

rooms.name: 26 Federal Plaza
rooms.note: A windowless interview room at the FBI New York Field Office, Sunday afternoon, December 30. Enter by the steel door in the back wall. The long table runs front to back; Evelyn sits at its head near the front wall, her two counsel (extras) on the left side, Quinlan at the near end with her closed folder, and the counsel's written statement lies on the table on the left side (table top at 2.4 ft). The observation mirror is on the right wall.

rooms.name: Silver Bell Bureau: the front hall
rooms.note: The Bureau's front hall. Enter from the village square through the front door in the back wall; the Jingle Division office is through the door in the front wall.

rooms.name: The Jingle Division office
rooms.note: The investigators' base. Enter from the front hall through the back wall. The board and timeline are on the left wall, the bell-tubes and the great bell on the right. Every reset starts here at 8:00 AM.

rooms.name: The village
rooms.note: The whole North Pole village in one walkable place on snowy hills. The clock tower stands on the hill at the north. Below it the square, with the old well-house in the middle and the great tree, ringed by Santa's Workshop (west), the Archives and the Guard house (east), the Engineering Lab and the Bureau (south). Clockmakers' Row runs north from the square's west side; Holly Lane's cottages sit down the slope to the northeast; the stables and sleigh hangar are down the hill to the southeast. Woods, lamps and lanterns between.

models.note: on the hill at the north of the village
long side along the left edge

doors.note: down the well; the grate needs Garrick's key, Aldric's master key or a Guard order

rooms.name: Aldric's workshop
rooms.note: The ground floor of the clock tower. Enter from the square through the oak door in the back wall. The gear train of the great tower clock fills the front wall. The stair up to the gear gallery is through the arch in the right wall. The tunnel hatch is in the floor, front left. The crank and key board hangs on the left wall. The body (loop 1, or any loop where Aldric dies) lies under the gear train with the writing beside it.

models.note: against the left wall, long side along it
hangs on the left wall pegboard; on the wrong peg after the murder
only when Aldric is dead

decals.note: glows in code; only when Aldric is dead

rooms.name: The gear gallery
rooms.note: The tall shaft inside the tower. Enter at floor level from Aldric's workshop through the arch in the back wall. A wooden stair (built in code) climbs round the walls in three flights with two landings: up the right wall, across the back wall over the arch, up the left wall to the landing at 22 feet and the chamber door in the front wall. The pendulum hangs in the middle. A good hiding place for a sting.

models.note: rises from the back left to the landing at the front left

rooms.name: The Chronometer chamber
rooms.note: The top room of the tower. Enter from the gear gallery landing through the door in the back wall. The great clock faces are in the front and left walls; the window in the right wall looks down on the square. The carved panel in the left wall hides Aldric's notebook and the Evergreen blueprints.

models.note: inside the case unless stolen

rooms.name: The tower cellar
rooms.note: Under Aldric's workshop. Reached by the ladder from the floor hatch (front right). The iron door in the front wall opens into the steam tunnels.

models.note: up to the hatch in Aldric's workshop

rooms.name: The steam tunnels
rooms.note: A long brick tunnel under the village. The back end opens into the tower cellar, the front end into the stables' boiler room. Halfway along, a side door in the left wall leads under the great clock. The alcove in the right wall is a hiding place.

models.note: along the right wall, near the ceiling
along the right wall, near the ceiling
along the right wall, near the ceiling
along the right wall, near the ceiling
along the right wall, near the ceiling
along the right wall, near the ceiling

rooms.name: Down the old well
rooms.note: A cramped stone chamber at the bottom of the old well's shaft. Reached by the iron ladder down the well from the square (it needs the well grate's key) or from the steam tunnels (back wall door). The Chronometer is hidden on the stone ledge beside the old bucket after 12:12 in a loop where it was stolen.

models.note: up the well shaft to the grate in the square
hidden here only after Garrick has stolen it

doors.note: up the well; the grate needs Garrick's key, Aldric's master key or a Guard order

rooms.name: Santa's Workshop: the toy floor
rooms.note: The busy main floor of the workshop. Enter from the square through the barn doors in the back wall. Santa's office is through the door in the front wall; the kitchen through the door in the left wall. The shift board and line clock hang on the right wall. Mira paints at the bench near the front right.

models.note: runs front to back

rooms.name: Santa's office
rooms.note: Off the toy floor. Enter through the door in the back wall. The window in the front wall looks out over the runway to the sleigh hangar. Marigold's office is through the door in the right wall.

rooms.name: Marigold Tinsel's office
rooms.note: Santa's chief of staff's office, off Santa's office through the door in the back wall. Her appointment book is on the desk.

rooms.name: The great kitchen
rooms.note: Mrs. Claus's kitchen, off the toy floor through the door in the back wall. Warm, busy, the place everyone passes through.

rooms.name: The Magical Archives
rooms.note: Enter from the square through the door in the back wall; the visitor log is on the desk beside it. Rows of tall shelves run front to back. The Tithe Register lies open on the lectern at the front. The charter and guild records are on the shelves.

models.note: a row of shelves, long side front to back
a row of shelves, long side front to back
a row of shelves, long side front to back
a row of shelves, long side front to back

rooms.name: The Engineering Lab
rooms.note: Enter from the square through the green door in the back wall. The covered globe stands in the middle at the front. The tool wall with the missing gear puller is on the left wall.

rooms.name: Clockmakers' Row
rooms.note: A narrow snowy street off the square. You come in through the arch at the back edge. Garrick's workshop is on the left, Corwin's shop and the glassworks on the right.

rooms.name: Garrick Thorne's workshop
rooms.note: Garrick's shop on Clockmakers' Row. Enter from the street through the door in the back wall. The bench is under the front window; his notes and sketches are pinned above it. The key ledger is in the locked cabinet on the right wall.

rooms.name: Corwin Sleet's clock shop
rooms.note: Enter from the street through the door in the back wall. Clocks everywhere. Corwin's letter of complaint is on the counter.

models.note: a watch big enough to pass for the Chronometer, for a decoy

rooms.name: The glassworks
rooms.note: Enter from the street through the door in the back wall. Aldric's escapement crystal waits in the case on the right until Pip collects it at about 11:40. The order slip is on the spike on the desk.

rooms.name: Holly Lane
rooms.note: A quiet lane of cottages off the square. You come in through the arch at the back edge. The Thornes' cottage is on the left, halfway down.

rooms.name: The Thornes' parlor
rooms.note: The Thorne cottage on Holly Lane. Enter from the lane through the door in the back wall. Mira's letters are on the side table by her chair; the family photographs hang on the left wall.

rooms.name: The stable yard
rooms.note: Off the square. You come in through the arch at the back edge. The stables are on the left, the sleigh hangar on the right facing the runway at the front edge. Garrick's escape route.

models.note: long side along the left edge

rooms.name: The reindeer stables
rooms.note: Enter from the yard through the sliding door in the back wall. Stalls line both side walls. The boiler room door is in the front wall, by the stable clock; Dasha saw Garrick go through it at 11:15.

rooms.name: The stables' boiler room
rooms.note: Behind the stables. Enter through the door in the back wall. The iron door in the front wall opens into the steam tunnels.

rooms.name: The sleigh hangar
rooms.note: Enter from the yard through the side door in the back wall. The great doors in the front wall open onto the runway. Santa's sleigh stands in the middle; the supply sleigh Garrick may try to leave on stands at the left.

rooms.name: The Guard house
rooms.note: Enter from the square through the door in the back wall. Captain Vell's desk is in front; two cells stand along the right wall.
